verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Jira bulk-edit, bulk-transition, or multi-item operation capability. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, Rovo automation rules, and JQL queries are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operations capability. Community API wrapper scripts are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
